stop: 30 total rounds or small-scope quality and token improvement confirmed twice
new_extension: Preserve original public SKILL.md nonindexed serialization line; check actual output vertex-use counts without reference geometry; no postprocessing or score changes. This is new experimental compatibility protection, not original Profy code.
proposer_data: DEV histories and original public skill only. Target outputs, verifier, reference coordinates and diagnostic gold-derived data are excluded.
adaptive_check_role: Previously inspected task used for iterative development checks, not independent held-out evaluation.
small_scope_success: Both compatible public tasks pass all original tests and output contract, total reported tokens below fixed original baseline; repeat both tasks once and require same conditions.
full_scope: Pending user clarification: 2 compatible tasks versus all 87 SkillsBench tasks with corresponding skills. No 261-call full-library job is authorized by assumption.
checkpoint: Each round is a separate command with STARTED/evolution/ROUND records; checkpoint private repo before another round.
